selection_policy: Review exactly one bounded repository-design target per local-day cycle using deterministic rotation. Review evidence never self-authorizes a repository change.

targets.review_question: Can the hourly Garden-design rotation or daily repository-review quorum be bypassed, self-authorize a semantic change, silently reduce the >=3 independent-family requirement, or review different evidence per family?
Do DesignEpoch, authority, change policy, repository profile and reference policy compose fail-closed without permitting a proposed change to authorize or classify itself?
Can executable functions obtain overly broad or ambiguous generated FunctionContracts, or can contract generation drift without explicit review?
Can any CI lane, receipt, reference-closure rule or workflow failure be bypassed or misrepresented as aggregate PASS?
Does the public MCP/discovery surface remain read-only, DesignEpoch/envelope-bound and invocation-time constrained under all declared tools and inputs?
Can swarm orchestration or synthesis amplify authority, confuse reviewer evidence with admission, escape resource bounds, or silently alter target semantics?
Do ActionGate, authority, DesignEpoch, delegation receipts and hardening fixtures preserve typed UNKNOWN/STALE, authority containment and fail-closed constitutional behavior?
Can release/version identity, archived predecessor snapshots, source roots or provenance drift while CI still advertises current conformance?
Do test ownership and attack-surface evidence cover the mechanisms they claim, and can a passing fixture be mistaken for broader semantic or empirical certification?

boundary: This matrix schedules repository-design scrutiny only. It grants no authority, proof, semantic admission, deployment permission or canonical Garden status.
